list: The 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18, cross-checked on PlanetGTA6. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written for this guide in our own words, and every guide names its sources.
note: GTA VI released on 2026-11-19, so some unlock methods are still being confirmed by the guides. Where a method is unconfirmed, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing one. All 55 trophies are offline and single-player; there are no online trophies.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first; this one pops on its own the moment the last of them unlocks, and there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan on roughly 200 hours in total, most of it spent on the 100% completion checklist behind A Long Road, so follow the roadmap stages in order rather than chasing this trophy directly.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so just play through it; the trophy pops when the mission ends and nothing here can be missed.

KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies unlock automatically when each chapter closes, so there is no separate task and nothing to miss. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude — that is the one thing in this chapter that might not come back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like every chapter trophy, it unlocks automatically when the chapter closes, so there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. It unlocks automatically when the chapter closes. Chapter 4 is also when the big bank vault jobs open up properly, so keep an eye out for the optional mission that unlocks them while you play through.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission at the end of Chapter 5. It unlocks automatically when the story ends and cannot be missed. The guides word it slightly differently — some describe it as completing Chapter 5 — but they agree it is the story finale, and free roam continues afterwards so nothing is locked off.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears during the story. Mission trophies pop as soon as the mission ends. There is no mission replay in this game, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as a safety net, even though story missions themselves cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked in-game under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist only becomes visible after the story. Every guide agrees this is the hardest and longest trophy, but also that it asks for only part of most activities, roughly 60% true completion. The checklist the guides report is: finish all five chapters; 100 optional tasks; all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vaults; 15 of 18 collectible card sets; 100 WAiNK scans; 33 underwater discoveries; 100 of 125 flamingos; 200 of 277 base-model vehicles; 100 of 255 animals studied; 50 of 66 weapons; all 42 shooting-range gold medals; all 42 drone time trials; 300 of 397 stunts; 70 of 80 challenges; and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Do the story first — progress made during it already counts — then work the checklist in free roam after the credits.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTABase — GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the driving and flying tricks the game counts — jumps, near misses and similar feats — and they add up across the whole playthrough, so they build naturally while you travel. KeenGamer describes them as unique stunts, so vary what you do rather than repeating one trick. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so this trophy pops on the way to that. Not missable.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. The guides count nine types in total — the activities on offer include fishing, arcade games, bowling, pool, mini-golf, basketball, races, drone races and the shooting range — so dip into each one as it opens up during the story and free roam. No source we checked lists the exact nine by name, so try every activity the game offers and watch the count. Not missable.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find the shooting ranges around Leonida and work through every challenge until each one shows gold — use the best weapon you have for each challenge type and replay the ones that fall short. The 100% checklist needs all 42 golds too, so this trophy is required for the platinum anyway. Ranges stay open after the story, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone time trials in total across those locations, and the 100% checklist needs all 42 completed, so learn each course, win the race at each location, and finish the time trials while you are there. Not missable.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count, so enter races as you find them around Leonida and win each one once. The 100% checklist asks for 30 of 40 races won, so this trophy pops on the way to that. Not missable.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take on the fishing challenge against Cal when it is offered and out-fish him — practise fishing freely first so you know how the casting and reeling works before the challenge. No guide we checked flags this as missable.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade machine, start a game and see it through to the end — any title counts, so pick the one you are best at. Not missable.

trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy is one of the Strangers & Freaks quest givers; follow his mission strand through to its last mission. GTAScoop names that final mission Puff Puff Pass. The guides report that quest givers tied to trophies come back after the story, so this is not missable — but do the strand when it appears rather than leaving it to the end.

trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton is one of the Strangers & Freaks quest givers; follow his mission strand through to its last mission. The guides note that some quest givers become temporarily unavailable during parts of the story, but those tied to trophies return afterwards, so this is not missable.

Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore; finish eight full strands, and the five character finals — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — count towards the eight. Keep an eye on the map for new stranger icons as the story opens up new areas, and mop up the rest in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total, at 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia, according to PowerPyx and the guides that follow it. This is the ONLY trophy any guide flags as possibly missable, and only because of one spot: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning. She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept, and do it before Chapter 1 ends. It is not yet confirmed whether that balcony meditation is actually required for the trophy (it raises the meditation counter but is not marked as a meditation spot like the others), so do it anyway to be safe. Two safety nets: the last meditation spot only opens once Jason and Lucia are playable together, after Chapter 2, and 100% completion needs only 15 of the 18 spots, so a missed spot cannot cost you A Long Road. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 in case.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret is a Strangers & Freaks quest giver tied to hunting; take his strand and hunt the unique animal he asks for. His Target Deck objectives — 15 in total — are also part of the 100% completion checklist, so work on those alongside this trophy. The guides note his strand is Jason-only.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect full sets, three of them, and this pops. The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 card sets, so this trophy comes early in that hunt — keep collecting and it leads naturally into A Long Road. Not missable; cards stay available after the story.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app on the in-game phone and scan things as you travel — unfamiliar vehicles, landmarks and other points of interest all count. Make it a habit from the very start of the game: scan everything new you meet, and the 100 comes steadily. The 100% checklist needs the same 100 scans. Not missable.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, according to PowerPyx, so 50 is enough for this trophy — and 70 are needed for 100% completion, which means you can skip the ten hardest challenges entirely. Work through the groups you enjoy first and leave the grindy ones for last. Not missable.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get the police up to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears — a fast car, a planned route away from the search area and a hiding spot off the road all help. Easiest to attempt when a mission or activity already has your partner alongside you.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Rob one shop, then two more in a row while the wanted level stays active — pick three shops close together, keep moving between them, and do not let the heat drop or get caught in between. Your partner needs to be with you for all three.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you find a new model — scan every unfamiliar vehicle you meet with the WAiNK app, which is also how you work towards You WAiNKer!. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so this trophy pops on the way to that. Not missable.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus during a firefight with at least five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends — a gang hideout or a shootout mission with a group of enemies bunched up is the place to try it. If it runs out early, reload a save and try again.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. KeenGamer describes this as stealing a departing passenger aircraft from the airport: get to the runway area and take a plane that is about to leave. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by the guides, so treat the method as reported rather than certain and check the cited guide for updates before attempting it.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino military tank and use it in combat, as KeenGamer reports it. Where Rhinos appear and how to steal one is still being confirmed by the guides — this guide will not invent a location. Check the cited guide for updates, and expect it to involve a military area or a high wanted level.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach, watch for cameras and staff sightlines, take what you came for and get out before anyone raises the alarm — a quiet entry beats a loud one here, since any detection fails the trophy. If you are spotted, leave and try again.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are the big jobs: the 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, and KeenGamer reports the vaults open up properly during Chapter 4, when the optional mission That's Where The Money Is... unlocks them. Do five vault jobs and get clean away after each one — this pops on the way to the full eight.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, take its cargo, then lose any wanted level and get away clean. Armored trucks travel set routes, so watch for one, block it, and have an escape vehicle ready before you start.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the state — the in-game map and progress screens show what is still unexplored. No source we checked gives a total count of areas, so do not trust a number until the guides confirm one; use the map itself as the check. Not missable.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are nine gangs in Leonida; hit at least one illegal operation for each of them. The 100% checklist needs all 39 gang operations, so this trophy pops during that grind — just make sure your hits spread across all nine gangs rather than repeating one. Not missable.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or viewpoint overlooking Ocean Beach and order a cocktail there. KeenGamer notes the exact trigger is still being confirmed, so treat the spot as reported rather than certain — the description itself only promises a cocktail and a view, and no source we checked has pinned down the precise bar or prompt yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description is a joke about driving a car through the showroom glass to escape; KeenGamer says the exact method is still unconfirmed, so this guide will not invent a showroom or a route. Check the cited guide for updates before attempting it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. KeenGamer reports this is not a game of bowling: it means stealing the three key valuables at the bowling alley and escaping — a smash-and-grab with specific targets. Get in, take the three valuables, and get out before security stops you.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. KeenGamer reports this means maximising the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia — train Strength with each character until it is maxed out. It is a slow grind, so start training early and keep at it between missions rather than leaving it all to the end.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile, as KeenGamer reports it. The profile tracks how you play — your choices and crimes — and the total builds up naturally across a full playthrough, so this should pop on its own if you play the game fully. One warning from the guides: the Irredeemable criminal profile cannot be undone, so do not chase this trophy by wrecking a profile you want to keep.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The unlock method is still unconfirmed — KeenGamer lists this hidden trophy with no confirmed method yet. The name suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but no source we checked confirms what that something is, so this guide will not invent a method. Check the cited guide for updates as the community pins it down.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy with no confirmed unlock method yet — the name suggests witnessing something strange out in the world, but no source we checked confirms what triggers it. Do not follow an unconfirmed rumour for this one; check the cited guide for updates as players work it out.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; fence them through your contacts until the total reaches $250,000. The 100% checklist needs the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy pops during that grind — keep robbing and fencing rather than spending the bills elsewhere.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy weapons, clothes, food and anything else from shops; the total is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds up naturally as you gear up. Big purchases help — the garages for Little Boxes also count as spending, so this trophy and that one move together.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total, according to KeenGamer. Garages are bought around Leonida; save up, since they are expensive, and buy every one. The money you spend here also counts towards Treat Yo Self, so the two trophies move together. Not missable.
